subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Tezcatlipoca's Mirrors
description: A fast breakdown of Tezcatlipoca's Mirrors for builders.

hook.text: Aztec trickster Tezcatlipoca carried a smoking mirror that revealed hidden truths—and shattered illusions.

buildup.text: He was the god of night, conflict, and change. His name means Smoking Mirror. He showed what you fear.

discovery.text: Tezcatlipoca drove the peaceful god Quetzalcoatl from Tula by showing him his own reflection—drunk and shamed.

twist.text: Destruction was necessary. The old era had to end for a new one to begin. Tezcatlipoca forced cosmic change.

climax.text: His mirror is truth weaponized. The trickster who destroys doesn't lie—he shows you what you can't accept.

punchline.text: The mirror doesn't lie. That's the problem.

quiz.question: What did Tezcatlipoca's smoking mirror do?
